why: Pass Postcombat Main. Combat is over, so Monstrous Rage loses its +2/+0 value if cast now (only the +1/+1 Monster Role token persists). Better to hold it for future combat turns. Burn spells (Incinerate, Searing Spear) need {1}{R} each; I only have {R} available from my untapped Mountain. Pass to End step to finish turn 4, then on turn 5 my creatures untap and I can attack again or cast burn to face.
